characterization_status: Pinned Django source, 76 deterministic pristine cases, and twelve runtime-captured corrected overlays are recorded.

get_api_v1_workspaces_by_slug_stickies.evidence_status: Pinned Django source and deterministic fixtures captured; seven format-suffix and five pagination corrected-runtime overlays are separately captured. Candidate replay and final acceptance are tracked in the proof ledger.

source_branches.observable: APIKeyAuthentication accepts X-Api-Key only; session cookie alone remains 401. WorkspaceUserPermission requires an active workspace membership and has no role threshold; inactive/nonmember is 403. Invalid API key is 403.

Collection queries and detail lookups are scoped by workspace slug and sticky owner; deleted Sticky rows are excluded. Detail get/patch/delete for absent, deleted, or another owner returns 404. Create explicitly resolves Workspace through its default manager and rejects a soft-deleted workspace; other methods join by workspace slug without applying that ancestor predicate. Unknown workspace slug fails membership permission with 403.

StickySerializer exposes model fields but required=false; id, workspace, owner, created_at, updated_at, description_binary are read-only. Nullable fields include background_color, color, created_by, deleted_at, description_stripped, name, updated_by. Empty PUT succeeds; descriptions accept object or JSON string; blank/null colors are accepted; HTML is sanitized. API response datetimes use the actor timezone. A top-level JSON array is rejected as non_field_errors with status 400 before mutation; update lookup precedes this validation. JSON null returns non_field_errors: No data provided.

List filters to current owner and active rows, orders by -created_at (not sort_order), supports case-insensitive description_stripped query and cursor/per_page pagination (default 20). Source validates cursor syntax before page size: per_page=0 with cursor=bad returns 400 Invalid cursor parameter.; per_page=0 with an overflowing cursor and a negative value below signed 64-bit range return generic 500. The corrected runtime rejects per_page <= 0 before cursor handling with 400 {"detail":"Error in parsing"}.

Create 201; list/retrieve/patch/put 200; delete 204 empty and soft-deletes the row. API-key use updates token last_used and queues process_logs; successful create/patch/put writes Sticky rows; successful delete also queues soft_delete_related_objects. Detail OPTIONS returns 200 and omits actions when its PUT object lookup raises a handled not-found error.

DRF DefaultRouter .json routes reach five custom handlers whose signatures omit format and produce 500; corrected-runtime overlays add optional format=None and capture successful route behavior. Unsupported .xml suffixes resolve 404 before auth. Inherited PUT accepts format.

differential_replay.sample_note: Detail probes use a seeded Sticky target; source fixtures cover per-operation authorization and missing/deleted/foreign-owner branches. Format aliases are recorded separately in the family corpus and proxy tests.

additional_protocol_evidence.note: DRF format suffixes are recorded in executable family parity and mount/proxy coverage; endpoint-retirement differential supports canonical and slashless forms.

differential_replay.request_body_note: The transport matrix sends explicit JSON arrays on POST/PATCH/PUT to compare deterministic serializer rejection. Successful writes, persisted fields, generated identities and durable effects are compared by the complete source/Go parity corpus; no response identity or creation timestamp is masked.
